label: weak diffuse feature in sequences beginning with l (esp. l l), around the delimiter
explanation: Sparse, low-magnitude feature (mean 0.135). Activations are dominated by sequences whose first original token is l (66% of mass, 19x lift) and by input l (53% of mass), concentrated at t=3..8 and on the first copy steps (recall_idx 1-2, i.e. re-inputting the leading l). Never fires at t<3 or on late copy steps (recall_idx>=4), and never when copying has gone wrong. However, it fires on only a small fraction of l-initial sequences: (orig(0)==l)&(recall_idx==1) has precision 0.03, and the best predicate (sequence starts l l, first copy step after DEL) reaches dev precision 0.41 but recall 0.12 (F1 0.19). Remaining activations are scattered over late original-phase tokens after 3/p/o with no capturable rule. No coherent predicate found.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+5.69), orig1=l (+3.95), phase=2 & in_tok=l (+3.08), orig0=w (+2.96), orig2=l (+2.91), prev_tok=3 (+2.85). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-4.33), correct=1 (-4.17), orig_idx=-1 (-4.14), recall_idx=5 (-3.12).
